intent: IMPLEMENT ReorderWindowBuffer so the stage 1 test passes, matching ast_hints exactly (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, non-blocking, no hardcoded operational values). Context: Chronology Reconciliation. Owns chronological order within the Backfill Reorder Window. Constructor ReorderWindowBuffer(Duration window) (window positive). Nested public record Result(List<TelemetryContracts.TelemetrySampleOrdered> released, boolean late, Duration lateness). State is kept per (deviceId, metricType) key: a watermark = greatest tDevice seen plus a buffer sorted by tDevice (ties by arrival). accept: if sample.tDevice < watermark - window the sample is LATE: it is not buffered, Result(empty, true, watermark - tDevice). Otherwise it is buffered (even if older than the watermark but inside the window, which re-indexes it chronologically), the watermark is advanced, and every buffered sample of that key with tDevice <= watermark - window is released as TelemetrySampleOrdered in ascending tDevice order; Result(released, false, Duration.ZERO). Ordering uses tDevice only, never tIngress. drain() releases everything buffered across all keys sorted ascending by tDevice per key and clears state. The buffer is inherently bounded by the window. Thread-safe (synchronized methods).
